ruleDefinitions.name: LOL-Binary Copied From System Directory
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious copy operation that tries to copy a known LOLBIN from system (System32, SysWOW64, WinSxS) directories to another on disk in order to bypass detections based on locations.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*copy\\ .*")) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*copy\\-item.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ copy\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cpi\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ cp\\ .*"))) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\robocopy\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\xcopy\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "robocopy\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "XCOPY\.EXE"))) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\System32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SysWOW64.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\WinSxS.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\calc\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\certutil\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\cmdl32\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\cscript\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\mshta\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\rundll32\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\wscript\\\.exe.*")))
